extracted.intended_audience: historians, scholars, and general readers interested in the history of the Protocols of the Elders of Zion, antisemitism, and early 20th-century Russian political propaganda
extracted.subtask_description: Close historical and textual analysis of the origins, versions, and authorship of the fabricated 'Protocols of the Wise Men of Zion', showing how different editions (Nilus, Butmi, Lutostansky) were altered, omitted, or plagiarized and situating them in the context of Black Hundred propaganda.
